```{r helper function for formatting p-values}
add_p_labels <- function(df, p_col) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      p_for_label = .data[[p_col]],
      
      p_for_label = ifelse(
        is.na(p_for_label),
        NA_real_,
        pmax(p_for_label, .Machine$double.xmin)
      ),
      # scientific notation with 2 significant digits
      p_sci = formatC(p_for_label, format = "e", digits = 2),

      # stars / n.s. based on the chosen p column (default: adjusted)
      sig = case_when(
        is.na(p_for_label) ~ NA_character_,
        p_for_label <= 1e-4 ~ "****",
        p_for_label <= 1e-3 ~ "***",
        p_for_label <= 1e-2 ~ "**",
        p_for_label <= 5e-2 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "n.s."
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-p_for_label) 
}
```

```{r reading in the data}
seurat_path <- file.path("data", "scMulti_HDM.qs2")  # processed single-cell object — see README (Data availability) for access
scData <- qs_read(seurat_path, nthreads = 8)
```

```{r gene lists}
genes_quiescent <- c("PAX7", "SPRY1", "NOTCH3", "HEY1", "HEYL", "CDKN1C", "CAV1", "APOC1")

muscle_maturation_panel_2 <- c(
  "MYH7", "TNNT1", "TNNC1", "MYL2", "MYL3", "ATP2A2", "CASQ2", 
  "MB", "MYOZ2", "ANKRD1", "TNNI1", "MYH1", "MYH2", "TNNT3", "TNNI2", 
  "TNNC2", "MYL1", "MYLPF", "ATP2A1", "CASQ1", "PVALB", "ACTN3", "AMPD1"
)

gene_lists <- list(
  Quiescence = genes_quiescent,
  Maturation = muscle_maturation_panel_2
)
```

```{r merging dSMCs clusters into one}
# Merge all dSMCs subtypes into a single "dSMCs" category
scData$cellType <- dplyr::recode(
  scData$cellType,
  "Myocytes" = "dSMCs",
  "dSMCs1" = "dSMCs",
  "dSMCs2" = "dSMCs",
  "dSMCs3" = "dSMCs"
)

Idents(scData) <- "cellType"

cat("Cell type counts:")
table(scData@meta.data$cellType)
```

```{r computing module scores for Quiescence and Maturation}
# Make sure these genes are present in the object (case matters!)
gene_lists_present <- lapply(gene_lists, function(x) intersect(x, rownames(scData)))

# Report any requested genes not found in the object (so silent drops are visible)
for (nm in names(gene_lists)) {
  missing <- setdiff(gene_lists[[nm]], rownames(scData))
  if (length(missing)) message(nm, ": genes not found and dropped -> ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
}

# Guard the list order so scores cannot be silently swapped, then use a single
# scalar `name` prefix (AddModuleScore's `name` is intended to be scalar).
stopifnot(identical(names(gene_lists_present), c("Quiescence", "Maturation")))
scData <- AddModuleScore(
  object   = scData,
  features = gene_lists_present,
  name     = "Module"
)

# Module1 = first feature set (Quiescence); Module2 = second (Maturation)
scData$Score_Quiescence <- scData$Module1
scData$Score_Maturation <- scData$Module2
```

```{r Maturation score boxplot by cluster and condition}
plot_maturation_by_clusters <- function(seurat_obj, selected_clusters = c("dSMCs")) {
  
  # Prepare the data
  plot_df <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::filter(condition %in% c("HDM", "HDM_FR")) %>%
    dplyr::select(cellType, condition, Score_Maturation)
  
  if (!is.null(selected_clusters)) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>% 
      dplyr::filter(cellType %in% selected_clusters)
  }

  # Visualization
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = condition, y = Score_Maturation, fill = condition)) +
    
    # Using geom_jitter_rast instead of geom_jitter
    # raster.dpi = 300 (or 600) is important for publication quality
    geom_jitter_rast(aes(color = condition), 
                     alpha = 0.2, 
                     size = 0.5, 
                     position = position_jitter(0.2),
                     raster.dpi = 300) + 
    
    # Boxplot (stays vector-based)
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8, lwd = 0.8, color = "black") +
    
    facet_wrap(~cellType, scales = "free_x") +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("HDM" = "darkgray", "HDM_FR" = "#667CFF")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("HDM" = "darkgray", "HDM_FR" = "#667CFF")) +
    
    labs(title = "Maturation Score Distribution", x = NULL, y = "Maturation Score") +
    
    theme_bw() + 
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray95"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Run it:
plot_maturation_by_clusters(scData)
```

```{r computing Wilcoxon test for Maturation score per celltype}
md <- scData@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(condition %in% c("HDM", "HDM_FR"))

wilcox_maturation <- md %>%
  group_by(cellType) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(condition) == 2) %>%  # safety check: only celltypes with both conditions
  group_modify(~ broom::tidy(
    wilcox.test(Score_Maturation ~ condition, data = .x)
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))

wilcox_maturation <- add_p_labels(wilcox_maturation, p_col = "p_adj") %>%
  relocate(p_sci, sig, .after = cellType) %>%
  select(-p_adj) %>%
  rename(p_adj = p_sci)

wilcox_maturation
```
